name: face-model-ravhead-v1
task: facial expression recognition (7 FER2013 classes) — an expression is what the face shows, not proof of a feeling

members.note: our v2-ferplus (EfficientNet-B0, FER2013 images + FER+ labels), 48x48 gray
HSEmotion enet_b2_8 (Savchenko 2022, AffectNet), 96x96 gray crop; contempt dropped; the graph also returns its 1408-d penultimate features (for the head)

input.g96: 96x96 uint8 gray of the same box (9216 bytes); without it only the 48 px member answers

crop.note: measured on FER2013: the 68-point box covers 0.82 of a FER2013 image side (median, 129 faces) and sits 0.16 box-heights below its centre

brow.note: brow-furrow cue from the 68 face points (brow_eval.py; RAVDESS a3-4 F1 0.614 -> 0.675, angry recall 0.25 -> 0.75)

head.note: RAVDESS-trained multinomial LR (Face-Lab/rav_head.py, 24 actors, leave-actors-out clips macro-F1 0.726 vs blendshape 0.591) on a 2 s window: mean B2 features + mean/max of the members' probabilities (no deployment prior); + 120 neutral dictionary-signing samples (signer false emotion 9.8%). RAVDESS CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 + HSEmotion/AffectNet: research use only.
head.prior_note: rav_prior.py / check_ravhead.py: neutral 0 / 0.5 / 1.0 → RAVDESS clips F1 0.726 / 0.723 / 0.711, signer false emotion (app path) 9.0% / 3.9% / 2.3% (deployed ensemble 2.0%)

speed_note: live label speed (Face-Lab/latency.py): window 2 s + tau 0.35 / hold 0.3 -> 1 s + tau 0.2 / hold 0.15: median time to the right label on RAVDESS 1.8 s -> 1.0 s, team false emotion 3.9% -> 3.1%
